title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Nosso propósito é cuidar de pessoas, prezando pela diversidade e enxergando o valor único de cada um.

Buscamos a excelência, exploramos todo o nosso potencial e focamos na melhoria contínua para surpreender positivamente e proporcionar uma boa experiência ao cliente. Reconhecemos nossas emoções, consideramos o impacto que geramos no outro e não permitimos que os desafios do dia a dia reflitam de forma negativa em nossas atitudes.

Seu propósito se conecta com o nosso? Conheça a vaga abaixo ou se cadastre em nosso banco de talentos:

Quem buscamos: Pessoas com bom relacionamento interpessoal, proativo, dinamismo, comunicativo, agilidade, pró atividade, espirito de equipe, discrição, flexível, visão analítica, boa fluência verbal, foco em resultados e solucionador(a) de problemas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Promover inspeções nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições perigosas, auxiliando a elaboração de mapas de risco e tomando as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de risco;
  • Criar condições mais seguras no ambiente de trabalho, através da inserção de critérios de segurança na elaboração de projetos de modificações prediais ou novas instalações;
  • Orientar as atividades desenvolvidas por empresas contratadas quanto aos procedimentos de Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Preparar programas de treinamento sobre segurança do trabalho, incluindo programas de conscientização, divulgação de normas de segurança e utilização correta de EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual), visando o desenvolvimento de uma atitude preventiva nos funcionários quanto à segurança do trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a CIPA em seus programas, estudando suas observações e proposições, visando adotar soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho;
  • Auxiliar na programação anual do SIPAT (Semana Interna Prevenção de Acidentes no Trabalho) acompanhando todo o evento;
  • Levantar dados para elaboração do plano de emergência contra incêndios, bem como organizar cursos para brigadistas e acompanhar reuniões;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Técnico completo em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Conhecimento em Legislação SST;
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Risco;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar como diarista.

Informações adicionais

Modalidade de Trabalho: Presencial

Benefícios que cuidam de você:

Para cuidar da sua saúde física, oferecemos plano de saúde e convênio odontológico.

Para cuidar da sua saúde social, Ações de Endomarketing para celebrar e criar conexões com os times e auxílio creche.

Para cuidar da sua saúde profissional, Refeitório no Local, banco de horas, vale-transporte, previdência privada e seguro de vida.

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

Se você sonha em trabalhar transformando vidas e reescrevendo histórias, seu lugar é no Pensi.

title: Engenheiro de Poços Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Poços Sênior para integrar a área de Engenharia de Poços, atuando de forma estratégica e técnica no planejamento, execução e otimização de poços offshore no Brasil, abrangendo poços subsea e surface.

Esse(a) profissional será responsável pelo ciclo completo do poço, desde as fases de conceito e planejamento até a execução, acompanhamento operacional e pós-poço, garantindo segurança, integridade, eficiência operacional e aderência a custos e cronogramas, em alinhamento com padrões corporativos e regulatórios.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, projetar e revisar programas de perfuração, completação e intervenção de poços subsea e surface, considerando requisitos técnicos, operacionais, econômicos e de HSE.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento técnico da execução offshore, suportando operações de perfuração, revestimento, cimentação, completação e testes, garantindo conformidade com o programa aprovado.
  • Avaliar riscos operacionais (well integrity, controle de poço, stuck pipe, perdas, estabilidade do poço) e implementar estratégias de mitigação alinhadas às melhores práticas da indústria.
  • Interface técnica com equipes de Operações, Subsea, Geologia, Reservatórios, SMS, Suprimentos e fornecedores de serviços (drilling contractors, service companies).
  • Liderar ou apoiar análises técnicas, revisões de projeto (DWOPs, peer reviews), AARs (After Action Reviews) e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Suportar processos de contratação e gestão de fornecedores, incluindo definição de escopo técnico, avaliação de propostas, acompanhamento de desempenho e controle de custos.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de processos, especificações técnicas, lições aprendidas e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) de poços.
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos regulatórios locais (ANP, IBAMA, Marinha) e padrões internos de governança e segurança de poços.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica;

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (Petróleo, Mecânica, Química, Civil).

Experiência prévia;

  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Poços offshore no Brasil.
  • Vivência comprovada em campanhas de perfuração em águas profundas e ultraprofundas.

Qualificações necessárias

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em projetos de poços, controle de poço, integridade de poços e gestão de riscos.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com múltiplas disciplinas e liderar discussões técnicas complexas.
  • Boa comunicação, organização, pensamento analítico e habilidade para tomada de decisão em ambientes operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em análise de desempenho operacional, AFE, estimativas de custo e acompanhamento de budget de poços.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e softwares de engenharia de poços (ex.: WellPlan, Wellcat, DrillPlan, Landmark, Drillbench ou similares).

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas

Dica:
Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

title: Analista de Produtos Jr
description:
A Mais.Mobi é uma empresa de mobilidade urbana com o propósito de repensar os setores de transporte e tecnologia para antecipar o futuro que as cidades e as pessoas desejam, a organização assume a gestão de diversos produtos e bilhetagens eletrônicas, como Riocard Mais e Cartão Macaé. Oferecemos soluções sob medida para o mercado, apoiando a atuação em atendimento, gestão, fidelização e meio de pagamento para transformar a mobilidade com segurança, transparência e suporte técnico.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo do cargo:
Atuar como facilitador-chave na identificação e no desenvolvimento de oportunidades que impulsionem o desempenho e otimizem os resultados de negócio do produto. Será o ponto de apoio na execução do roadmap, trabalhando em colaboração direta com equipes de Negócio, Tecnologia e UX/Design, para garantir que as entregas estejam perfeitamente alinhadas com as necessidades dos usuários e os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

Principais Atividades:

  • Domínio do Produto e do Mercado
    : Desenvolver uma compreensão aprofundada da cadeia de valor do produto, incluindo o modelo de negócio, o cenário competitivo de mercado e a arquitetura técnica, para fundamentar decisões com expertise sólida.
  • Gestão e Priorização de Melhorias (Backlog):
    Gerenciar o fluxo de melhorias e demandas, priorizando o backlog com base em valor de negócio e esforço, e buscar ativamente soluções inovadoras que aprimorem a experiência do usuário e os resultados.
  • Articulação e Interação:
    Atuar como a ponte de comunicação, promovendo a articulação eficaz entre as áreas internas (Tech, UX, Marketing) e o mercado/clientes, apoiando a expansão e adoção do produto.
  • Análise de Dados Estratégica:
    Desenvolver, manter e apresentar relatórios (periódicos e ad-hoc) utilizando ferramentas como Qlik Sense (ou similar). Transformar dados brutos em insights acionáveis para a tomada de decisão.
  • Suporte à Estratégia de Dados:
    Colaborar no mapeamento de problemáticas de negócio, identificando a necessidade de novos painéis de análise e garantindo a assertividade e inovação das informações geradas.
  • Proposta de Soluções:
    Documentar e estruturar as necessidades e as possibilidades de solução, preparando as argumentações e o material de suporte (dados e informações) para apresentações e discussões estratégicas de negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior
    completo
    em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Marketing ou áreas afins.
  • Domínio do
    Pacote Office
    (principalmente Excel e PowerPoint).

    Visualização de Dados
    (ex.: Qlik Sense, Tableau, Power BI) para criação de dashboards e relatórios.

Desejável:

    .

title: Venue Design Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Venue Design Manager reports to FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and FIFA Senior Venue Design Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 requires venue design of as a key central delivery to fully integrate and visually represent all operations, legacy information and complementary structures required for the tournament. The Venue Design Manager is responsible for leading and implementing the venue design from block planning through to final design across a cluster of official FIFA stadiums and venues.

Role to transition into onsite Venue Overlay Manager during final Event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Raw Data Management:

  • Reception, validation and conversion of raw data into clean base CADs

Application of FIFA Drawing Standards:

  • Drawing updates according to FIFA standards and templates (layers, colour codes, line styles, annotation, legends, layouts, naming conventions etc.)

Drawing Updates:

  • Integration of operational content (space allocation, perimeters, flow data, capacities, space tags), legacy information (base infrastructure, legacy usage/annotation/signage) and complementary structures (fences, commodities, FF&E layouts etc.) as required.

Application of BIM 360 workflows:

  • Management and interaction of central database for drawing development, communication, change requests and publications.

Implementation of Space Requirements:

  • Application of requirements according to FIFA Event Platform (EP) and venue limitations.

Drawing Publications:

  • Delivery of drawings sets according to inspections and project timelines (site plans, levels, seating maps, pitch plans, catwalks, sections, detailed layouts etc.)

Ongoing Collaboration:

  • Continuous collaboration and support for Venue Management and FIFA Functional Areas.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Services and Overlay teams, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience managing multi-venue overlay projects, from design to delivery, preferably for major sporting events (e.g., FIFA, Olympic Games).
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure and spatial planning.
  • Excellent organisational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent drawing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver to tight deadlines.
  • Knowledge of local construction regulations and permitting processes in host country (desirable).
    Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Front-end Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview


At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview


Taking great ideas from concept to reality is what innovative companies do. At Motorola Solutions, we believe true innovation occurs when a new technology solves a problem customers didn't know they had or in a way they never thought possible. We strive to deliver solutions that bring the right information, to the right person, at the right time. We help our customers be their best in the moments that matter most – protecting citizens, connecting with shoppers and empowering IT operations.

Our growing family of web-based products are driven by our custom-built Design System, and we are looking for passionate engineers to help evolve the system with new components designed to meet the needs of our growing product portfolio. Working with the Design Team, you will be responsible for building components used throughout the company; helping developers around the world make beautiful products with a single, unified vision.

Job Description


We are looking for passionate front-end developers. Are you using CSS to repaint your kitchen? Angular to create your living room? Join us. You will be responsible for the development of beautiful, fully-functional, flexible components - meeting the needs of every product team across the company, by supplying robust, stable, reusable components that align to our broader design vision, and meet the mission critical needs of first responders in their day to day work.

Your responsibilities will include front-end development of standardized framework components, implementation of new components for the larger Design System, harvesting components from existing products (and ensuring they are generalized to work in other applications), fixing and updating existing components, optimizing all code for best-practice experience, and helping the Design System team advance a holistic ecosystem through development best practices in everything you implement. You will work in an agile environment, cooperating with other front-end engineers and UI/UX experts, remaining considerate of the needs for accessible code and components.

Basic Requirements


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Math or related fields
  • Effective verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Proven experience with HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Angular, React, JavaScript, TypeScript and other front-end related languages
  • Experience with unit testing frameworks
  • Ability to solve challenging technical problems under time pressure
  • Ability to drive the problem to the solution without being supervised
  • Flexibility in the approach to work and tasks

Skills nice to have:

  • Proven experience in working for open source software development groups
  • Experience with modern frameworks like React or Polyme
  • Familiarity with Angular Material or any other component librarie
  • Experience in building large and modular codebases
  • Understanding principles of component-driven architecture
  • Proficient understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to work around them
  • Web application testing tools and frameworks like Protractor, Selenium
  • ecosystem including Webpack, Express, Gulp and
  • Server side scripting using Java & NodeJS
  • Understanding of accessibility patterns
  • Focus on fluent user experience, usability and excellent performance

Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

  • Gestão de riscos: Analisar cláusulas críticas de LGPD, rescisão, multas e confidencialidade, garantindo a segurança jurídica nas negociações;
  • Interface com escritórios externos: Atuar como ponto focal entre a empresa e os escritórios jurídicos nas áreas societária, trabalhista, tributária e civil;

title: Network Solution Architect
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.
Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.


Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non-functional and functional state-of-the-art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement
Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud-based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big-picture goals inform technical details and vice-versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi-cultural/multi-country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Defendemos nossos valores de respeito aos clientes, às pessoas, aos acionistas, ao meio ambiente e aos fatos em todos os lugares onde estamos presentes.
Nós nos importamos em dar as pessoas uma melhor maneira de seguir em frente.
Seja parte de um time no qual você é empoderado e encorajado a alcançar o seu potencial ao máximo e a realizar as suas ambições.
Ao redor do mundo, através da diversidade, ajude a criar o futuro da Michelin com paixão, entusiasmo e orgulho.
Com a mesma atenção aos nossos colaboradores e clientes, nós inovamos além e melhor pela sustentabilidade.

Valorizamos as singularidades de cada um e consideramos a diversidade como um valor, por isso reforçamos este convite para você, que se autodeclara negro ou negra, do gênero feminino ou masculino, LGBTQIA+, pessoa com deficiência ou acima de 50 anos.

Missão do Cargo

Atuar nos projetos de investimento industrial, garantindo a disponibilização dos equipamentos necessários para atingir os objetivos com a melhor relação desempenho/custo, seguindo padrões e boas práticas.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir Pré-estudos para definir soluções eficientes.
  • Liderar a concepção ou integração, respeitando normas internas e externas, sistema de qualidade e processos de capitalização e arquivamento.
  • Coordenar a realização, instalação e colocação em funcionamento dos equipamentos.

Resultados Esperados

  • Estudos de viabilidade realizados com análise de custos, prazos, riscos e critérios funcionais.
  • Integração conduzida em cooperação com outros métiers.
  • Gestão de solicitações de mudanças conforme processos internos.
  • Implementação de sistema de qualidade e métodos (análise de risco, AMDEC, revisão de design, planejamento de qualidade, etc.).
  • Validações obtidas após fases de realização e inicialização dos equipamentos.
  • Apoio aos projetos de protótipos das equipes de desenvolvimento de processos.
  • Dossiês "como construído" atualizados.

Perfil Desejado

  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica (ou técnica em Mecânica/Eletromecânica);
  • Experiência em projetos industriais;
  • Conhecimento em normas internas e externas, sistemas de qualidade e ferramentas como AMDEC* (FMEA);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e conduzir projetos multidisciplinares;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Vale-alimentação

  • Ambiente colaborativo e oportunidades de desenvolvimento

title: SDGs Analysis Consultant
description:
Result of Service

The SDG Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the project's team and the operational, technical, and communications teams of UN-Habitat Brazil in Rio de Janeiro. He/She may also collaborate with municipal and state government officials, media, and civil society organizations.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Seven (7) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Program (UN-Habitat) is to promote the sustainable development of human settlements and policies that lead to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners to implement the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient, and connected places, with better opportunities, where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin America and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative and socially fairer urban economic, social and environmental policies. UN-Habitat initiated a project with the State Government of Rio de Janeiro (Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – GERJ) that aims to strengthen urban resilience in the State of Rio de Janeiro based on the implementation of the 2030 Agenda and the New Urban Agenda principles. The project Inclusive and Sustainable Rio helps the State to achieve urban prosperity while implementing global sustainable urban development agendas. In particular, the proposal focuses on increasing its urban resilience through the development of disaster prevention and mitigation actions. The "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit" is part of the Inclusive and Sustainable Rio initiative. Its primary byproduct is a report aiming at providing technical guidance, building local capacities, being a tool to strengthen connections, alliances and collaboration between local and state governments focused on the review of the implementation of the SDGs and the Agenda 2030 locally. To support the implementation of this project and UN-Habitat's mandate in Brazil, an SDGs Analysis Consultant is required to work on the "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit". Report to UN-Habitat Manager The SDGs Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The SDG Analysis Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Write a report concerning the a regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. b) Analyse the data and systematise it according to the characteristics of the regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. c) Visit selected regional territorial unit to validate the information and discuss priority projects. d) Prepare and organize participatory technical workshops. e) Provide, when possible, an integrated perspective on basic urban services such as housing, mobility, energy, water, sanitation, etc. and their vulnerability to extreme weather events. f) Support reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. g) Be responsible for maintaining an organized and accessible information file. h) Maintain close communication with counterparts and local partners, such as the governments, civil society organizations, universities, private sector, etc. i) Be responsible for ensuring that all activities observe the principles of integrity of the United Nations. j) Participate in weekly virtual meetings—and occasionally in-person meetings—held during regular working hours throughout the product development phase, upon request. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The SDGs Analysis Consultant shall assist in the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Situation Analysis Report Description: The situational analysis serves as a diagnostic of existing data and policies and their alignment with the SDGs, with the aim of establishing subnational coherence with the 2030 Agenda and identifying opportunities for action. The Situation Analysis Report must contain: (i) collection of information to identify indicators, policies and instruments related to the objectives of the VLR; (ii) alignment with the SDGs and other measurement tools for tracking progress towards the 2030 Agenda; (iii) availability and identification of data sources to assess data accessibility, quality, and availability, preferably disaggregated by population subgroups and geographic areas; (iv) prioritization and selection of indicators; (v) analysis of secondary data and policies, including, where possible, an assessment of their alignment with the VLR objectives, while highlighting successes, gaps and areas for potential improvement; and (vi) mapping of relevant stakeholders. The Situation Analysis Report will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 90 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) must contain: (i) in-person workshops for stakeholders to assess the Situation Analysis Report of the VLR; (ii) complete review and analysis of all collected data and its relation to the SDGs; (iii) strategic vision for the state government, considering the collected evidence to understand the current status of the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iv) recommendations to achieve the SDGs, establishing specific actions and paths to achieve the SDGs, filling the existing gaps identified. The output will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 120 days after signing the contract. Product 3 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (final version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit (final version) must contain: (i) consolidation of deliverables (products 1 and 2), adjusting to the revisions requested by the UN-Habitat team and the Government of Rio de Janeiro; (ii) in-person workshops for stakeholders to present the preliminary content of the VLR and strengthen institutional capacities to implement the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iii) an executive summary synthesizing the overall performance of government policies within the SDGs, key findings, recommendations, and challenges to strengthen the localization of the policies. The output will consist of two separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction, an executive summary of up to five pages, and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. All volumes must follow the templates adopted by UN-Habitat. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Additional formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 180 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required.
• Postgraduate degree (Latu Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of professional experience in Urban and Regional Planning, working within or in close collaboration with public administration at the federal, state, and/or municipal levels, is required.
• Experience in work involving knowledge of and engagement with Brazil's National Urban and Environmental Policies, particularly their respective instruments, is required.
• Experience in work related to international, national, and subnational good practices on Voluntary Local Reviews (VLRs) is required.
• Experience in public policy analysis and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), with demonstrated expertise in intersectoral approaches, monitoring and evaluation, and the analysis and development of indicators and scenarios is required.
• Previous experience in social mobilization and participatory activities involving public officials, civil servants, and civil society is required.
• Professional or academic experience — such as research positions — in urban-environmental public policy and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is required.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Proficiency in technological tools such as Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word), and referencing and formatting tools such as Bib Tex is required.
• Exceptional narrative report writing and editing skills, as well as proficient use of Brazilian Portuguese, are required.
• Knowledge and experience in qualitative and quantitative analysis of socioeconomic indicators are required.
• Knowledge and experience in handling databases from Population Censuses, administrative records, and other statistical surveys are required.
• Previous research experience aligned with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the New Urban Agenda is desirable.
• Knowledge and experience with the administrative divisions and territorial organization of the State of Rio de Janeiro are desirable.
• Good command of programming and data analysis in R software is desirable.
• Good handling of online event and conference tools is desirable.
• Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competency:
• Professionalism: experience working in inter-institutional environments; project management; monitoring and evaluation; and the development of approaches and strategies related to good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and Organization: professional approach to work and a strong sense of responsibility, with the ability to operate independently. Proven organizational skills and the capacity to manage workload efficiently and meet established deadlines.
• Communication: ability to write clearly and effectively; actively listen and interpret messages accurately; respond appropriately; demonstrate openness in sharing information and keep relevant stakeholders informed. Strong abstract reasoning skills and a proven ability to produce written materials tailored to diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: ability to work collaboratively within teams; demonstrate leadership, conflict resolution, and consensus-building skills; work effectively in multicultural and multi-ethnic environments while respecting diversity. Demonstrates sensitivity to the mainstreaming of vulnerability and a willingness and ability to operate in challenging contexts. Knowledge Management:
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 – BRL: Total net amount). UNOPS Salary Scale. title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator
description:
Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams' time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver's license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Fixed Term - Full Time

Brazil

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

Please note: this hybrid position is based in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating.

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. The problems are complex, the systems are massive, and the pace is fast. This Senior Fullstack position is a unique opportunity to join our engineering team in Brazil.

Lead with impact as you design, build, and maintain user-facing features end-to-end that directly support how people and things move in the real world.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain robust, scalable full-stack solutions for the centralized pipeline, ensuring high performance, safety, and reliability at scale.
  • Navigate messy, high-impact problems in fast-changing environments, often without a clear starting point, to ship thoughtful and practical solutions at speed.
  • Own your work end-to-end: from the first design doc to debugging production issues when the stakes are high for our global user base.
  • Champion engineering best practices such as code health, comprehensive testing, and system design clarity.

What You'll Need

  • +7 years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining complex large-scale applications.
  • Expertise in one or more backend languages (e.g., Go, Java, or Python) and frontend technologies (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, and React).
  • Experience with distributed systems, microservices architecture, and designing high-throughput, low-latency APIs.
  • Proven ability to own project development end-to-end, including requirements gathering, architecture design, coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Advanced English communication skills, written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with globally distributed cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points If

  • Experience leading the technical direction of complex, cross-functional projects with multiple dependencies.

This role involves close collaboration with end customers to identify their safety needs, position our products as optimal solutions, and oversee the homologation of our PPE portfolio within these companies.

Once the products have been homologated, the final sales process will be facilitated through our channel partners (distributors). The ideal candidate should have a proven track record in sales, excellent skills in communication, relationship-building, and understanding customer requirements to drive growth while partnering with distributors to ensure market penetration and customer satisfaction.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Market Development & Lead Generation

  • Identify, research, and prospect new business opportunities with end customers (major companies with high PPE utilization).

  • Develop and implement a strategic approach to penetrate targeted accounts in the assigned territory

  • Customer Needs Assessment

  • Collaborate with key decision-makers at prospective companies to understand their safety and compliance requirements

  • Provide consultative support to educate customers on the beneftis and propor use of PPE solutions

  • Product Homologation Process

  • Present the company's products and ensure compliance with customer specifications and regulatory standards

  • Work closely with customer stakeholders (e.g. procurement, safety, and compliance teams) to sucessfully homologate products.

  • Sales Process & Partner Collaboration

  • Liase with channel partners (authorized distributors) to coordinate the sales process post-homologation

  • Ensure effective distributor support to meet customer needs and maintain excellent service levels.
  • Provide constant after-sales support to end customer to ensure that our solutions are meeting their expectations and keep our installed base.
  • Give technical trainning to end customers or distributors

  • Attend Trade Shows or specific Safety events withint the customer plant

  • Relationship Management & Customer Retention

  • Build long-term relatioship with end customers to ensure repeat business and foster loyalty to the company's PPW brand

  • Proactively address customer concerns to provide solutions and strengthen trust

6.Market Insights & Reporting

  • Stay updated on competitor activities, market trends, and emerging demands in the PPE industry
  • Prepare accurate sales forecasts, activity reports, and pipeline updates for the Regional Sales Manager

Informações adicionais

  • Use seu Vale-Refeição para saborear deliciosas refeições.
  • Sabe todos aqueles produtos maravilhosos da Granado e da Phebo? Você poderá comprar com desconto exclusivo

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Vendedor I
description:
Quer trabalhar na maior empresa de bikes elétricas do Brasil?
Nascemos em 2010, no Rio de Janeiro.
A nossa missão desde então é fazer com que as pessoas reflitam sobre os seus hábitos.
E não apenas os hábitos relacionados à mobilidade urbana.
Queremos que as pessoas olhem mais ao seu redor.
Como você leva a sua vida?
Qual é a sua relação com a natureza, com o tempo, com o seu trabalho, família e amigos?
A nossa marca não é apenas sobre bicicletas elétricas.
A Lev é sobre escolhas, como escolher o caminho mais bonito em vez do mais rápido.
E por falar em caminho, que ele seja sempre a melhor parte.
Muito prazer, nós somos a Lev.

-Precisou trabalhar além do seu horário habitual? Temos Banco de horas para que use essas horas.

-Para as mamães e papais 'de plantão', temos o Auxílio Creche;
-Curte treinar? Oferecemos Totalpass para você e mais 3 dependentes Porque malhar sozinho é muito chato, né?
-Benefícios Creditas: rede de empréstimo consignado, elegível para solicitar após 3 meses da admissão.

-Oferecemos a possibilidade de troca de VT pela bike, para sua locomoção casa/trabalho e trabalho/casa, após 6 meses da admissão.

Triagem de currículos: nesse primeiro iremos analisar o seu currículo de acordo com os requisitos necessários para a vaga;
Entrevista do Talent Acquisition: um de nossos recrutadores agendará uma entrevista por competências e fit cultural, além de ser uma oportunidade para você conhecer mais sobre a empresa;

Experiência em vendas dinâmicas com ações de vendas.
Perfil comportamental: alto astral, extrovertido, novas ideias e inovações.

description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

Os times das plataformas de engenharia de dados são responsáveis por disponibilizar todo o ferramental de tratamento das informações capturadas, permitindo a sua transformação em dados estruturados. Além do uso interno, essas ferramentas também estão integradas nos Plugins para uso dos clientes. Essas plataformas incluem os serviços de parsing e estruturação de dados, serviços de validação de dados, serviços de associação de entidades, armazenamento e gestão de passagens, e criação e gestão de metadados, dentre outros.

Requirements

Habilidades necessárias:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou algum curso relacionado;
  • Experiência prévia na área de desenvolvimento;

  • Ter contribuído com o desenvolvimento de pelo menos 3 (três) projetos na área;
  • Familiaridade com lógica de programação, conhecer e entender conceitos básicos como sintaxe, tipos de dados, variáveis, operadores básicos, condicionais, loops, e funções, e conhecer e entender estruturas de dados básicas, tais como vetores e listas;
  • Conhecer e entender sobre complexidade de algoritmos, conhecer e entender conceitos relacionados a Orientação a Objetos, tais como classes, objetos, encapsulamento, polimorfismo, herança, e abstração, e conhecer e entender estruturas de dados mais avançadas, tais como pilhas, filas, árvores, e tabelas hash;
  • Familiaridade com comandos, atalhos e funcionalidades mais usados da IDE no dia-a-dia, ter familiaridade com versionamento de código, conhecer os serviços de nuvem mais utilizados, saber utilizar a ferramenta de atualização de status de tarefas, e saber utilizar a ferramenta de comunicação interna da empresa;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de software (design patterns).

O que faz brilhar os nossos olhos:

  • Experiência com C# ou Python;
  • Experiência em uso de ferramenta de versionamento de código (GIT);
  • Experiência com computação em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Experiência em documentação e manutenção de processos.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


Responsável pelo acompanhamento em tempo real das imagens captadas pelas câmeras de segurança, com foco na identificação de comportamentos suspeitos, movimentações irregulares e situações anormais. Deve realizar o registro detalhado de ocorrências e elaborar relatórios diários ou sob demanda, conforme os procedimentos da empresa.

Auxilia no controle de acesso remoto de pessoas e veículos, validando entradas e saídas com base nas imagens e utilização de interfones. Garante a preservação das gravações, verificando se o sistema está registrando corretamente, realizando backups e arquivando imagens sempre que solicitado.

Executa verificações periódicas nos equipamentos de monitoramento, como câmeras, monitores, DVRs/NVRs e conexões, comunicando falhas técnicas ao setor responsável para manutenção preventiva. O MAIOR HUB DE EDUCAÇÃO E TECNOLOGIAS PARA A PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL.

A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica.

Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya iClinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.

A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em

Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia. #VemSerAfya

title: Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant
description:
About TTC

The Testing Consultancy (TTC) is a global specialist software testing company with a focus on helping organizations transform the way they deliver quality software. We have broad capabilities across a wide range of testing areas including SAP testing and TOSCA automation that enable our clients to increase the speed and quality of software development while reducing risk and cost.

Perks of working for TTC

  • Open to C2C
  • Competitive Base Salary
  • Work Life Balance
  • Relaxed Work Environment
  • Growth and Development Opportunities

Summary

The primary purpose of the Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant role is to lead and deliver SAP testing and TOSCA automation services to customers using industry standards and best practices to meet TTC customer requirements. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant will work collaboratively to build and establish the overall QA process with a focus on SAP landscapes and model based test automation through TOSCA. Responsibilities for this position also include mentoring QA personnel on SAP testing methodology, TOSCA frameworks, automation strategies, and other technical aspects. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant may also assist in general application support of SAP production applications and systems, managing relationships with business owners, software vendors, auditors, and internal IT teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong SAP functional knowledge, deep hands on experience with TOSCA automation, and the ability to lead both functional and technical discussions. They must be proactive, strategic, technically strong, and capable of performing hands on work as required.

Responsibilities

  • Consult with the customer on the design and implementation of comprehensive Test Activities across SAP modules and TOSCA automation that satisfy Test Objectives and ensure sustainable product Quality throughout the SDLC
  • Advise on all aspects of QA including SAP specific best practices, establishing metrics, applying leading TOSCA automation strategies, and developing tools and processes to meet quality goals
  • Develop, plan, execute, and maintain SAP test cases, TOSCA scripts, plans, and protocols for solutions under development
  • Participate in the deployment of SAP enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and major implementations
  • Complete User Acceptance Testing to validate the end to end business flow across SAP modules
  • Identify opportunities for SAP test process optimization and TOSCA framework improvements with a focus on continuous improvement and customer value
  • Establish and evolve formal QA processes for SAP projects ensuring that the team is using best practices and scalable TOSCA automation approaches
  • Act as a key point of contact for all QA aspects of SAP releases and TOSCA automation delivery while managing customer expectations
  • Work with project management to meet SAP testing milestones and deliver high quality automated and manual testing solutions on time
  • Lead, collaborate, and mentor QA team members on SAP testing methods and TOSCA automation best practices while sharing domain knowledge to expand team capabilities

Technical Skills

  • Hands on experience with TOSCA automation including modules, test case design, execution, and automation framework development
  • Strong knowledge of SAP modules such as FIORI, MM, PM, SD, FICO, PP and QM, BW, EWM, BPC, APO, or others
  • Experience automating SAP applications using TOSCA including navigation, test case recording, and building reusable automation assets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication with the ability to explain SAP and TOSCA technical concepts to internal and external stakeholders
  • Leadership skills with the ability to mentor QA professionals in SAP testing and TOSCA automation
  • Ability to work independently, meet SAP project timelines, and adapt to changing requirements
  • Experience with SDLC including SAP business planning, data analysis, functional requirements analysis, and application design
  • Strong decision making and problem-solving skills related to SAP functional and TOSCA automation challenges
  • Ability to evaluate information from multiple SAP sources, assess risks, prioritize user needs, and design appropriate test solutions
  • Experience working in Agile and Waterfall development environments
  • Knowledge of large-scale SAP deployments, implementations, support, and upgrade projects

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Information Systems, or Computer Science
  • 7+ years of experience in Software Development and Quality Assurance including User Acceptance Testing, Functional Testing, Performance Testing, Manual and Automated Testing. UAT experience is required
  • 3-6 years of SAP Functional Testing experience
  • 2-4 years of hands-on TOSCA automation experience
  • ISTQB Certification preferred

If your experience or qualifications are similar to our ideal candidate, please consider applying. Experience comes in many forms, skills may be transferable, but passion for your career cannot be substituted. At TTC, we recognize the value of diversity and the unique perspectives it brings. We encourage everyone to apply.

title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description:
This position is based on a Cruise Ship

Education and Experience Requirements

· Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university.

· Hold a current valid medical license.

· Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required.

· Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups.

· Fluency in English.

· Strong interpersonal skills.

Reports to: Spa Manager

Job Summary

The Medi-Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to on onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures, safely and effectively, and be able to explain accurately all aspects of the products and services, to the guests. They must have excellent communication skills and be able to provide aesthetic medical solutions, safely and effectively, to address the concerns of on board guests. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to work with The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist them with the sales, marketing, and promotional aspects of the position. The Medi–Spa Sales Consultant will also translate for the Medi-Spa Physicians if necessary. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to gain the knowledge of the spa services and products in effort to cross-promote these services to guests. The Medi-Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi – Spa Sales Consultant. Position requirements Possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to the guests Work closely with the Medi–Spa Sales Consultant Must have enthusiasm and possess excellent customer service skills Must be able to give an effective presentation as it relates to medi-spa services Enjoy working with people and possess a friendly and outgoing personality Excellent communication and listening skills Basic computer knowledge Must be a team player Duties and Responsibilities

· Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment.

· Provide consistent professional medi-spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld's medi-spa protocols.

· Conduct patient follow-up as required.

· Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest.

· Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control

. · Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld.

· Prior to all services, complete with the guest the Medical Record which must be stored at the completion of each cruise in the Spa Manager's office or designated place within the spa facilities for a period of 2 years. (3 years on Cunard and P&O).

· Cross-promote other spa services.

· Uphold the standards of sanitation and sterilization as directed by ship and company policy and procedure. · Properly clean and restock medi-spa treatment room as required.

· Manage medical product and supply inventory.

· Communicate to management any and all occurrences involving staff or guests in the spa that require attention.

· Handle guests' questions and concerns professionally and courteously.

· Provide accurate, appropriate and immediate responses to all requests by guests.

· Maintain a positive attitude and contribute toward a quality work environment.

· Regularly attend, participate in and support training and staff meetings for the spa.

· Required team meetings: embarkation day meetings and sea day team meetings.

· Assist in all areas of spa operation as requested by management.

· Train new spa staff in medi-spa services/cross-promotion skills – follow up must be carried out to ensure staff are confident with services and promotions.

· Follow Medi-Spa Operations Policies.

· Email report daily and inventory report with every end of cruise report. General Guidelines

· For all guests, doctors must review the guest consultation information with them prior to the service.

· All guests receiving treatments (including complimentary treatments) must complete the required consent forms. Doctors are required to complete a medical record for each guest.

· At conclusion of the treatment, review Aftercare Instructions with the guest and provide them with a copy. · Conclude by thanking the guest for the opportunity to take care of them. Schedule a follow-up appointment and assist them with scheduling at the front desk.

· Clean your room and set up for your next guest.

· Do not stand around the front desk between services. Treatment room should look the same at the start and end of every day and between each guest. This means the room must be:

· Clean – sanitize work surfaces and sink area; store trash is proper receptacles.

· (biohazard/sharps/trash); All trash must be taken out daily or when full.

· Organized –stock boxes should be out of sight and all supplies must be organized or stored properly

. · Inviting – the treatment bed must be properly dressed and proper ambience with regards to music and temperature. End of Day Checklist

· Dispose of open unused needles

· Dispose of Bio-Hazard bag if full

· Take Sharps Container to Medical facility if full

· Sterilize table and countertops

· Fill out inventory control form

· Lock product storage cabinets

· Lock treatment room

· Email daily revenue report to shore side team Service booking policy A clean, non-intimidating, state-of-the-art and stress-free environment is not only what we strive to offer our guests, it is the goal for our staff as well. A critical element to the success of our spa is our ability to work together as a team. If we are unable to work seamlessly together, our guest will be the first to notice. It will not only hurt the business of our spa but will affect your individual success in this industry. Following are some policies that we have put in place to help us avoid unnecessary contention:

· Medi-Spa Physicians may only be booked for services for which they are qualified to administer.

· In some cases, it is impossible to fairly book services if you are not qualified to perform all services.

· Medi-Spa Physicians are not allowed to refuse or trade services that they are certified to perform. Guest requests cannot be moved or changed without the Spa Manager's approval. All staff members are required to perform general duties during their scheduled hours, as directed by the manager onboard. General duties may include, but are not limited to, promotional duties, port cleaning, staff meetings, training and stock inventory. Please be guided by your Spa Manager's instructions. Guidelines for Protection and Sanitization (known as 'GPS')

· Be familiar with OneSpaWorld's 'GPS' to safety. ·

Understand and practice the required self-screening procedures.

· Understand and follow the agreed upon procedures for symptomatic guests or employees.

· Understand and adhere to staff and guest Physical Distancing Policy.

· Understand and adhere to Staff Personal Hygiene Policy.

· Understand and adhere to the Hand Washing Policy.

· Arrive at the spa between five and ten minutes prior to assigned shift start time. · Understand proper use and disposal of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the modality and for handling soiled linen, waste, and chemicals.

· Be familiar with the approved disinfecting products available at the spa location including proper use, contact time, disinfection methods and proper storage and handling procedures.

· Understand and adhere to the Treatment Room Preparation requirements.

· Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable modality and services performed.

· Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable spa area.

Understand the Sanitation Log Policy and complete logs as required.

· Understand and adhere to the Retail Product Handling and Transferring Procedure.

· Understand and adhere to the Product Sampling Procedure.
